hit.Keywords: Cool Flame Transitions     Ground-based experiments     Counterflow flames     Extinction Limit

meta.title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation / Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
meta.objective: By using the Flame Extinguishment (FLEX) experimental data from the Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) system of combustion science, the purpose of this grant was to conduct new simulations and ground-based experiments using ozone-sensitized counterflow flames.
meta.approach: Using the experimental conditions of FLEX flight, a comparative study of the oxygen concentration effects on the extinction limits of cool flames was conducted.
